A container has the shape of a right circular cone. The height of the container is $20\,\text{in}$ and the diameter at the top of the container is $10\,\text{in}.$ Water in the container is evaporating so that its depth, $h$, is decreasing at a constant rate of $\frac{10}{3}\,\text{in/h}.$ At what rate is the volume of water decreasing when the water depth is $12\,\text{in}?$

Question 19

A container has the shape of a right circular cone. The height of the container is 20in and the diameter at the top of the container is 10in. Water in the container is evaporating so that its depth, h, is decreasing at a constant rate of 103in/h. At what rate is the volume of water decreasing when the water depth is 12in?

a
60π in3/h
b
30π in3/h
c
40π in3/h
d
54π in3/h
e
96π in3/h
